description: Generate hierarchy, focus interaction and exact copy (REQ-024; C51, G16; R06, R10, R11, R21, R23, R25; V01, V02; AC-C51-01, AC-R024-01..08; JOURNEY-024), reconciling UAT #286. On the real /generate route Goal and Focus lead the one card on one wrapping row in the shared .clr-intent-summary recipe (src/ui/refinements/presentation.css); the Focus value is itself the change control (a keyboard disclosure named by what it shows, with aria-expanded/aria-controls and a chevron cue), so no detached or paired Change focus remains; Recovery is reached inside the focus choices as its own session toggle, apart from the four mutually exclusive movement focuses, and is never recommended or selected for a first workout, nor banned; Place and Notes carry no helper lines while labels, controls, the Notes placeholder, errors and the request are unchanged; MINUTES fits through the shared public Input unit contract (src/styles/fields.css); the title is Generate and the action Generate workout; Back stays the shared framed icon-only control named Home. #286's contracts are kept: first-workout explicit required Anchor, collapsed recommended Focus with a one-workout override, stored Goal, Intensity 1-10. The accepted gallery state /gallery/refinements?state=screens (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d) draws the route's own GenerateBack, GenerateIntent and GenerateContextFields over an in-memory draft that sends nothing. check-01 runs the whole of src/app/Generate.test.tsx (its superseded Place/Notes helper retention and paired-action assertions migrated to the approved removals) and requires the named TASK-024 cases; check-02 proves the route in the browser at 320 and 390 with a contained synthetic session: touch, keyboard, reduced motion, reload, a first workout, a failed generation keeping the draft, and the gallery state. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-024 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/app/Generate.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
